highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed rendering and text-shaping performance while correcting stream lifetime behavior.
highlights_body: Image pixel copies and HarfBuzz text encoding allocate less during repeated use, while native feature-string decoding avoids an unnecessary allocation.

bullets.lead: Managed image and text shaping allocations reduced
bullets.detail: Image pixel copies are optimized, and HarfBuzzSharp reuses its UTF-32 encoding buffer to reduce allocation pressure in repeated rendering and shaping workloads.
Parsing OpenType feature strings no longer allocates native memory unnecessarily while preserving the existing decoded results.
Corrects front-buffered stream retention so buffered data is not kept alive longer than intended.
